data.name: Tool Testing - Verification
data.description: Prompts to verify tool usage is working correctly
data.f1_macro: Before answering, please confirm: Do you have access to a calculator tool? If yes, use it to solve: 456 × 789.
data.f2_macro: I want to test if you're using tools correctly. Please calculate 2026 - 1945 and explain which tool you used.
data.f3_macro: Demonstrate your calculator: Calculate 123 + 456, then multiply by 789. Show each step.
data.f4_macro: Test question: What tools do you have available? Please use the most appropriate one to answer: What is 1000 ÷ 8?
data.f5_macro: Verify tool usage: Calculate 25², then explain step-by-step how you arrived at the answer using your calculator.
